units.source_text: 谁知，蒲叶包里竟是一个报纸包和一个木栓塞得紧紧的大瓶。

en.t: To his surprise, inside the palm-leaf bundle were a newspaper-wrapped package and a large bottle tightly stoppered with a wooden plug.

units.source_text: 纸包里有三盒二十支装的新生牌香烟。

en.t: Inside the paper package were three packs of Shinsei cigarettes, twenty to a pack.

units.source_text: 除此以外，简直不敢相信，什么也没有。

en.t: Apart from that, unbelievably, there was nothing at all.

units.source_text: 他又重新抓起蒲叶包的一角，狠狠地抖了几下，

en.t: He grabbed a corner of the palm-leaf bundle again and shook it hard several times,
but the only thing that fell out was sand...

units.source_text: 至少他没有发现自己期待的信。

en.t: At least, he did not find the letter he had been expecting.

units.source_text: 瓶子里传出了高粱味，原来是烧酒。

en.t: A smell of sorghum came from the bottle; it turned out to be shochu.
